content_sections.heading: UAS Dharwad Project Assistant - Remote Sensing and Geographic Information System (RS & GIS) Walk-in Interview Date, Time and Venue
content_sections.text: The venue is given in the official notification (see the link below).

content_sections.heading: UAS Dharwad Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. SAC/NSMP/57/2026-27 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download UAS Dharwad notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Bachelors in Geo-informatics / Remote sensing and Geographic Information System; or Bachelor in Technology; or Any Bachelor's Degree with 3 years working experience in RS and GIS software Experience: 3 years working experience in RS and GIS software (for candidates with any Bachelor's Degree) Other conditions: The appointment is temporary for 179 days or until the project ends. Candidates must bring original documents for verification. The university reserves the right to terminate the service at any time without notice. Selected candidates must execute a bond on Rs. 100/- stamp paper.

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for UAS Dharwad Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates arriving after 10.00 am will not be considered for the interview / written test

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Temporary appointment for 179 days or till the end of the scheme or until government clarification/approval on temporary appointments, whichever is earlier Appointment may be terminated at any time without giving reasons No right to any permanent appointment in the University Before joining, undertaking on Rs. 100 stamp paper in Format-TR-2 required

rows.event: Skill and Typing Test (10.30 am to 11.30 am)

content_sections.heading: How Will UAS Dharwad Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Skill and Typing Test Interview Skill and Typing Test on 25.11.2026 from 10.30 am to 11.30 am Interview on 25.11.2026 at 12.00 pm On equal interview marks, SC/ST candidates get preference

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Filled application form (annexure) with photograph Original documents of qualification, experience and other relevant records Photograph Two bound sets of attested copies of documents

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for UAS Dharwad Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill the application form given as an annexure to the notice. Report at the Office of the Associate Director of Research (Headquarters), UAS Dharwad on 25.11.2026 between 09.15 am and 10.00 am. Register your name and sign in the registration book between 09.15 am and 10.00 am. Submit the filled application form with two attested copies of documents at registration. Bring all original documents for the interview. Do not send the application in advance under any circumstances.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Candidates attend the interview / skill test at their own expense Applications must not be sent in advance Scheme: National Soil Mapping Programme (NSMP), account head 560135/310

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for UAS Dharwad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 25 November 2026, and candidates report at 9:15 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in UAS Dharwad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies for Project Assistant - Remote Sensing and Geographic Information System (RS & GIS).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for UAS Dharwad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 25 November 2026 at 9:15 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 30,000 per month (Consolidated).

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Bachelors in Geo-informatics / Remote Sensing and Geographic Information System or Bachelor in Technology or Any Bachelor's Degree with 3 years working experience in RS and GIS software.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. The appointment is temporary for 179 days or until the project ends. Candidates must bring original documents for verification. The university reserves the right to terminate the service at any time without notice. Selected candidates must execute a bond on Rs. 100/- stamp paper.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates arriving after 10.00 am will not be considered for the interview / written test.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Skill and Typing Test. Interview. Skill and Typing Test on 25.11.2026 from 10.30 am to 11.30 am. Interview on 25.11.2026 at 12.00 pm.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Temporary appointment for 179 days or till the end of the scheme or until government clarification/approval on temporary appointments, whichever is earlier. Appointment may be terminated at any time without giving reasons. No right to any permanent appointment in the University.
